required_facts_checked: The cohort projects covered personal, professional and health-related tasks.
bAIpacking retrieves race evidence for cyclist equipment and uses PostgreSQL, RAG and offline judging.
Meal-Map uses 28 documents and nine tools, with 20-request and $0.50 daily limits and deterministic fallback.
Decision Memory indexes around 21 documents and returns structured decision cards with monitoring.
VoiceIssue creates GitHub issues from Telegram voice and requires confirmation before creating the issue.
The medical transcription app uses local Whisper, diarisation and local Llama entirely offline.
Cyber Sachet answers in English and Nepali with citations and uses intent-selected tools and evaluation.
SnapSplit reruns OCR and escalates mismatches to human review.
AMR combines BM25 and BioBERT retrieval through reciprocal-rank fusion over 15 sources.
The regulation assistant uses local retrieval, Brave Search, Jina Reader and legal services across European, US and Dutch jurisdictions.
